gemini.rationale: The product and operational assets transferred entirely to EQT, meaning no structural mismatch between T4 and T5 (gap_45 = 0). However, the Rice board explicitly anticipated that many employees would not be retained, and equity awards for non-continuing employees were settled at closing, indicating a structural mismatch between the transferred operations and the retained workforce (gap_56 = 1). No transitional services agreement was documented to mitigate this gap.

grok.rationale: gap_45=0 because the slice describes a whole-company merger in which Rice’s customer-facing E&P and midstream assets (T4) and the operating segments that produce them (T5) crossed together into EQT RE, LLC as successor in interest, with no product-vs-process structural split at closing. gap_56=1 because the same closing structure expressly bifurcated the workforce: the Rice board factored in ‘the expectation that many Rice employees will not be retained by EQT following completion of the merger,’ non-continuing equity awards were cash-settled at closing, and a Separation and Release Agreement was executed for Daniel J. Rice IV, so processes transferred while only a subset of the organization aligned. No transitional-services or operating agreement absorbing that people gap is documented in the slice.

openai.rationale: Rice transferred as a whole-company merger, including its exploration-and-production and midstream segments, so the customer-facing assets and associated operations crossed the ownership boundary together; this supports gap_45=0. The people tier was structurally incomplete because the Rice board expected many employees not to be retained, while only continuing employees had awards converted and two named Rice principals were designated for EQT board seats; therefore, processes transferred without the full organization that operated them, supporting gap_56=1. The slice documents no transitional-services or operating agreement allocating this mismatch at closing.
